verdict.rationale: Dropbox publishes a documented public HTTP API. The Files API covers creating, reading, editing, moving and deleting files and folders, and there are reference pages for OAuth scopes, webhooks and content hashing. Official SDKs exist in several languages, including JavaScript and Python on GitHub with working code samples. missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (probes returned 404 at all candidate paths), markdown/LLM-friendly API docs (docs-md probe 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the API in use.
